source_title: Futures (are) in the Making: The FEDORAS Materials Repository
overview: All materials aim to support science and sustainability teaching and Open Schooling Network activities through interdisciplinarity, futures thinking, and new forms of expression. Some resources are single lessons, others are longer projects.
slidebook: Discover the materials through the slidebook
grant: FEDORAS Academy received funding from the European Union under the program ERASMUS-EDU-2024-PEX-TEACH-ACA — Grant Agreement n° 101196137.
project_intro: The FEDORAS Academy builds on decades of educational research and policy work to respond to one urgent question: How can teacher education better prepare young people for the complex, interconnected futures they are entering?
project_resources: All resources shared here are developed through the FEDORAS Academy, as part of a collaborative, research-based process involving teachers, researchers, and design partners across Europe.

pillars.Futures Thinking: fostering imagination, futures literacy, and the ability to envision and shape possible futures.
pillars.Interdisciplinarity: encouraging connections across disciplines to address complex societal challenges.
pillars.New Languages: exploring innovative forms of communication, creativity, and expression for science education.

concepts.Open Schooling Networks (OSNs): Five regional clusters in different countries where innovation is tested, refined, and shared
concepts.Co-design: Bringing together teachers, researchers, and communities to develop context-specific educational practices
concepts.ChangeLabs: Local action spaces for experimenting with new practices

greencomp: This work aligns with the European Commission’s GreenComp (European sustainability competence framework) and the Council Recommendations on key competences for lifelong learning.
references: Akkerman, S.F., & Bakker, A. (2011). Boundary crossing and boundary objects. Review of Educational Research, 81(2), 132–169.
European Commission (2022). GreenComp: The European sustainability competence framework.
